name: codex-reset-scheduler
description: Schedule automatic redemption of your existing Codex banked resets before they expire.

scripts.build: pnpm clean && node scripts/release-version.mjs generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/prepare-bin.mjs
scripts.build:test: pnpm clean && node scripts/release-version.mjs generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.lint: node scripts/release-version.mjs generate && eslint src test scripts/native-product-*.mjs scripts/release*.mjs scripts/package-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm security:secrets && pnpm test && pnpm test:native-harness && pnpm test:release && pnpm build && pnpm pack:dry
